name: read_file
description: Read a text file of your worktree, one page at a time (at most 2000 lines). Each line starts with its number. If the last line says `[more: ... offset=N]`, call again with offset N. A negative offset reads from the end. A binary file is not shown. Example: {"path":"src/main.rs","offset":2001}

path.description: Path relative to the worktree root

offset.description: First line, from 1; -50 = the last 50 lines

repo.description: The slot to read in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.
